title.value: LANTERN-RD: Enabling Deep Learning for Mitigation of the Invasive Spotted Lanternfly
title.justification: The paper discusses the creation of LANTERN-RD, a dataset aimed at mitigating the invasive spotted lanternfly using deep learning.
title.quote: LANTERN-RD: Enabling Deep Learning for Mitigation of the Invasive Spotted Lanternfly

extractions.description: The paper presents LANTERN-RD, the first curated image dataset of the invasive spotted lanternfly and visually similar insects. It enables computer vision research aimed at mitigating the SLF's impact, which threatens local biodiversity and agricultural economies in places like the Northeastern United States and Japan. The dataset, alongside a baseline convolutional neural network (CNN) and a mobile classification application, empowers rapid identification and responsible public mitigation efforts.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper explicitly focuses on mitigating the impact of the spotted lanternfly, an invasive species threatening biodiversity and agriculture, through the use of deep learning technologies.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: To enable computer vision applications and motivate advancements to challenge the invasive SLF problem, we propose LANTERN-RD, the first curated image dataset of the spotted lanternfly and its lookalikes.
